units.source_text: 不过，抚养苗子的村濑家拥有杉林产业，在此地也算是不错的，

en.t: the Murase family who had raised Naeko owned cedar forestry holdings,
and were considered fairly well off in this area,

units.source_text: 苗子还不辞辛苦地为他们干活，所以即使被千重子知道了，

en.t: and Naeko still worked hard for them without sparing herself,
so even if Chieko were to find out,

units.source_text: 也不至于给他们增加麻烦。

en.t: it would not necessarily cause them any additional trouble.

units.source_text: 也许有杉林产业的人，要比那中等规模的衣料批发商殷实得多。

en.t: were far more prosperous than that medium-sized textile wholesaler.
